name: Eric Carle Museum of Picture Book Art
source: The Eric Carle Museum’s exhibition, Collection Highlights and Featured Artists pages
note: The Carle’s permanent collection has more than 9,000 objects by more than 250 artists, mostly fragile works on paper that are shown in rotating exhibitions, so most are not on view. It has no public collection database yet. This list is what the Carle shows online: the works pictured for its current shows (many of them loans) and its Collection Highlights and Featured Artists pages.
